headline: A 2021 law renamed the Homestead National Monument of America in Nebraska as the Homestead National Historical Park.
what_it_does: This law changes the official name of the Homestead National Monument of America, located near Beatrice, Nebraska, to the Homestead National Historical Park. It is a renaming only and does not describe any change to the site's land, budget, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 13, 2021.
